children: On 10 September 2026, AB Artea bankas received permission from the European Central Bank for Oleg Marofejev, currently Head of Information Technology and Data Division of the Bank and Chief Technology Officer (CTO), to serve as a member of the Management Board.

Oleg Marofejev as a new member of the Management Board on 14 May 2026. As noted in the decision, his appointment as a member of the Management Board was subject to the approval of the supervisory authority.
Oleg Marofejev is considered to be a member of the Management Board of the bank since 10 September 2026.

title: Oleg Marofejev starts serving as a member of the Management Board of AB Artea bankas
